**0.8.1: transcription history, exported as CSV.**

- New: every take is kept on your phone (text, length, model, and how long it took to transcribe). Dictation → *Transcription history* → **Export CSV** saves it through the file picker, so you can put it straight into Google Drive. Nothing is uploaded by the app.
- The CSV has one row per take with the time, text, word count, audio length, model, where you dictated (keyboard, floating mic or Try it), and the transcription timings (decode time, real-time factor, wait after stop) with the phone and app version. Its first columns match the desktop app's history export.
- *Keep transcription history* turns it off; *Clear history* deletes it. The history starts with this version: earlier takes were not stored.
- Not yet tested on a device. arm64-v8a only. Android 9+. Downloads: [hebrish.app/download](https://hebrish.app/download).
